context: Add explicit transport configuration to benchbox/mcp/cli.py and the server lifecycle: --transport {stdio,streamable-http}, --host, --port, --streamable-http-path, and a documented legacy-client policy. Default to stdio. For HTTP, default host to loopback and delegate discovery, version negotiation, request metadata, and validation to SDK 2. Enable stateless_http for the legacy protocol leg only after documenting the loss of legacy sampling, elicitation, roots, and resumability, none of which current handlers use. Keep JSON-response mode off unless a separate streaming/progress decision approves it.
description: BenchBox currently invokes server.run() without a transport argument and therefore exposes only stdio. Add an explicit dual-transport CLI and modern Streamable HTTP endpoint using MCP 2026-07-28 sessionless requests. This is a new deployment surface, not removal of a problematic existing HTTP session design. Keep stdio compatible and keep HTTP loopback-only until the separate authentication and tenancy gate is complete.

anti_patterns.instead: retain the SDK streaming-capable default pending a separate decision
anti_patterns.why: it can preclude future progress notifications and streamed behavior

anti_patterns.dont: implement MCP protocol headers, discovery, or version negotiation by hand
anti_patterns.instead: exercise SDK behavior through protocol-level tests
anti_patterns.why: the SDK already owns these version-sensitive rules

anti_patterns.instead: add HTTP as an explicit opt-in transport
anti_patterns.why: existing Claude Code, Codex, and desktop integrations depend on local stdio

preserves.behavior: Existing stdio startup remains the default with no required new flags
HTTP binds only to a loopback interface until the remote-security TODO is complete
stdio and HTTP publish equivalent tool, resource, prompt, and input-schema contracts

prior_art.concept: official Streamable HTTP and stateless_http behavior
